title: Fry Seasoning
description: From the r/hellofresh DIY spice blend master list, scaled so one batch (about 3 tsp) replaces one sachet. Original ratio: 1 garlic powder, 1 onion powder, 1 sweet paprika.

steps.text: Mix everything in a small bowl. Use the whole batch wherever a recipe calls for 1 sachet.
To keep a jar: multiply every amount by the same number (e.g. ×8 fills a small spice jar).
